earnings.title: 11011 Sunset Hills Road
highlights: Revenue $14.6 billion, up 12.9% versus prior year
Diluted EPS $4.49, up 15.7% versus prior year
RESTON, Va . – General Dynamics (NYSE: GD) today reported third-quarter 2026 operating earnings of $1.5 billion, and $4.49 per diluted share (EPS), on revenue of $14.6 billion.
Compared with the year-ago quarter, revenue increased 12.9%, operating earnings increased 14.7%, and diluted EPS increased 15.7%.

quotes.text: Our business had exceptional third quarter results, with revenue growth across all four segments, robust bookings and solid operational performance.
quotes.by: Phebe Novakovic, chairman and chief executive officer
